rawContent: Help the Black community by supporting their businesses and organizations. You can find those near you here (search available by state): https://t.co/d8zMW1M2EB #BlackLivesMatter #BlackBusinessesMatter

Parisians gathered earlier today in front of the Tribunal de #Paris to show their support for the #BlackLivesMatter movement. Sign on the right reads: “Who protects us from the police?”| Photo: Louis Pisano. #France https://t.co/29bHYxYz7e

Earlier today, Parisians gathered at the Porte de Clichy in #Paris in support of the #BlackLivesMatter movement and in protest of the death of a young black man named Adama Traoré, who died in police custody in 2016. #AdamaTraore | Video by: @_a_nn_e_
“RACISM SUFFOCATES. NURSES UNITED.” - A group of nurses who participated in the protest earlier today in Paris against racism. #BlackLivesMatter

“What happened to Floyd happens everyday in this country... in every area of American life. It’s time for us to stand up in George’s name and say ‘GET YOUR KNEE OFF OUR NECKS’”- @TheRevAl at #GeorgeFloyd’s memorial service. #JusticeforGeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

Meanwhile in France, another protest against police brutality, this time in the city of Lille. People have gathered to ask for #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd and for Adama Traoré, who died in police custody in 2016. #JusticePourAdama #BlackLivesMatter
8 minutes and 46 seconds of silence in memory of George Floyd during the George Floyd Memorial, led by Rev. Al Sharpton: https://t.co/zuJcsRl9fV #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

Meet #AssaTraoré, the brave woman behind #France’s #BlackLivesMatter movement. Her brother Adama died in French police custody in July 2016. She and her family seek justice and an end to racial discrimination and police violence: https://t.co/EYmYqOzYC2 #JusticePourAdamaTraore https://t.co/r3honlyb2l
Today in Paris: protesters on their knees demanding justice for Adama Traoré. #France #BlackLivesMatter #JusticePourAdamaTraore
